title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw the first line starting at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending at (0.0273, 0.0). Draw the second line from (0.0273, 0.0) to (0.0273, 0.0117). Continue with the third line from (0.0273, 0.0117) to (0.0, 0.0117), and complete the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0117) back to the origin. Apply a sketch scale of 0.0273 to transform the two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are set to zero, no additional transformation is required. Extrude the scaled sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The resulting shape is named "Cylinder," with a length of 0.027343750000000003 units, a width of 0.011718750000000002 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units. This cylindrical object has a rounded top and a flat bottom.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0273, 0).lineTo(0.0273, 0.0117).lineTo(0, 0.0117).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

     .lineTo(0.0273, 0.0) \

     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0117) \

     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular section
